size_help.when: Real attention on size-guide/size-picker (not just page dwell).
size_help.title: Between sizes?

missed_discount.when: A missed_discount offer exists (a code not yet applied) and there's hesitation on cart/checkout.
missed_discount.title: Save on your order
missed_discount.body: Use {code} to save {currency}{saving} on your order.

auto_discount_active.when: An auto_discount_active offer exists (already applied automatically) — informational only, no code to mention.
auto_discount_active.title: Discount applied

similar_on_promo.when: A similar_on_promo offer exists and there's real attention or a return visit on the current (non-promo) product.
similar_on_promo.title: Worth a look

delivery_gap.when: A delivery_gap offer exists with a real hesitation signal (cart/checkout page + dwelling or bouncing).
delivery_gap.title: Almost free delivery
delivery_gap.body: Add {fill_with_name} ({currency}{fill_with_price}) and delivery is free — you're {currency}{gap} away.
delivery_gap.tone: Concrete, exact amounts, one clear ask.

cart_under_threshold.when: A cart_under_threshold offer exists (an open cart under the free-delivery threshold, any gap size) while the shopper is BROWSING (not already on cart/checkout — that's delivery_gap's recipe instead).
cart_under_threshold.title: Free delivery is close
cart_under_threshold.body: Add {fill_with_name} ({currency}{fill_with_price}) and delivery is free — you're {currency}{gap} away.
cart_under_threshold.tone: Concrete, exact amounts, one clear ask — same voice as delivery_gap.

checkout_bounce.when: patterns.checkoutBounce is true — the shopper reached checkout and then left to a different page (a login wall, a back-nav to cart/shop) without a later checkout visit.
checkout_bounce.title: Still want it?
checkout_bounce.body: Your cart is saved — pick up where you left off.
checkout_bounce.tone: Reassuring, no blame, one clear next step.

search_help.when: search.results is exactly 0 for the shopper's current search.q AND the store found 1-3 real catalog matches (offers[].candidates).
search_help.title: Found a match

stuck_checkout.when: Rage clicks or repeated form-field friction on /checkout with no concrete offer fact to hand over.
stuck_checkout.title: Trouble checking out?
stuck_checkout.body: You can also complete payment via {payment_method} if this isn't working.
stuck_checkout.tone: Calm, offers an alternative, no blame.

low_stock.when: facts.keys.stock is low for the current product/selected variant — a concrete near-miss fact.
low_stock.title: Almost gone
low_stock.body: Only {stock} left in {size_selected} — grab it before it's out.
low_stock.tone: Urgent but factual, one concrete number.

exit_intent_help.when: exit_intent fired (mouse left upward, or tab hidden then visible) — a real leaving signal, not scroll noise.
exit_intent_help.title: Before you go
exit_intent_help.tone: Brief, no guilt-trip, one concrete reason to stay.

atc_nudge.when: atc_hesitation fired — hovered/focused add-to-cart repeatedly without clicking.
atc_nudge.title: Ready when you are
atc_nudge.tone: Reassuring, answers the likely hesitation (size/stock/fit), not pushy.

variant_help.when: variant_churn fired — 2+ size/color switches within 30s, no add-to-cart yet.
variant_help.title: Need a hand choosing?
variant_help.tone: Direct, practical, no pressure to decide fast.

promo_hint.when: promo_focus_empty fired — focused the promo code field and left it empty.
promo_hint.title: Have a code?
promo_hint.tone: Helpful, only mention a code if one is actually active.

total_reassure.when: total_dwell fired — real attention (not a glance) on the cart/checkout total or shipping line.
total_reassure.title: About that total

search_refine_help.when: search_refine fired — 2+ different queries within 60s, still narrowing.
search_refine_help.title: Still looking?
search_refine_help.tone: Offer one concrete next step, not a generic 'try again'.

idle_check_in.when: idle fired — no input for 20s+ on a product/cart page, lowest priority, only when nothing else applies.
idle_check_in.title: Still there?
idle_check_in.tone: Very low-key, easy to ignore, never a hard sell.

low_stock_nudge.when: page fact: low_stock — page_context scan found stock text naming a low count for the current product/variant.
low_stock_nudge.title: Almost gone
low_stock_nudge.tone: Plain fact, no artificial urgency beyond the real number.

free_shipping_gap.when: page fact: free_shipping_gap — page_context/cart_economics shows a real, small gap to the free-shipping threshold.
free_shipping_gap.title: Almost free shipping
free_shipping_gap.tone: Plain gap fact, no upsell tone.

delivery_reassure.when: total_dwell or atc_hesitation fired and a real delivery estimate is known (business.delivery / page_context delivery text).
delivery_reassure.title: On its way

compare_back.when: product ping-pong — comparison block shows a previously viewed product cheaper than the current one.
compare_back.title: Comparing?
compare_back.tone: Neutral, informational — never pushy about switching.

size_availability.when: page fact: variant_out_of_stock, or variant_churn — page_context scan found per-option availability for the current product.
size_availability.title: Sizes in stock
size_availability.body: {unavailable} is sold out here, {available} are in stock

spec_diff_hint.when: page fact: undecided_compare — 2+ same-category PDPs viewed within 3 minutes without reaching the specs/details section, and a real spec_diff was computed. Card `cta` carries only ONE action (contract fixed shape) — prefer `open_product` (the compared product) since that's the more useful single tap; the widget's own product-details anchor (see `anchor` below) is where policy.js redirects a card whose target_hint isn't visible, not a second cta.
spec_diff_hint.title: Comparing?
spec_diff_hint.body: Comparing this and {other_title}? The other has {feature} — in case that's what you're after.
spec_diff_hint.tone: Helpful, one concrete differentiator, never pushy about either product.

review_confidence.when: long PDP dwell (element attention / return visit) and page_context scanned a rating + review count.
review_confidence.title: Well reviewed
